_note: How a card tag behaves, read off all 1294 shipped cards. 'marker' tags are present or absent: every vanilla use is exactly 1. 'stat' tags carry a number and their observed range is listed. The editor renders a marker as a checkbox and a stat as a number input with that range.

allTagNames._note: Every tag defined in tag.json, so the editor can offer a real key instead of free text. usedOnCards marks the ones that actually appear on a card in vanilla. A card tag key that is not one of these names is inert: the engine registers its tag conditions from tag.json, so nothing can test it.
